title: 信息日报 2026-08-02

headline.title: GPT-5.6 大幅降价：Luna 版降幅高达 80%，AI 性价比迎来新基准
headline.summary: OpenAI 今日对 GPT-5.6 系列实施大幅降价：Terra 版降价 20%，Luna 版降价 80%。这一举措由 GPT-5.6 Sol 优化负载均衡等技术驱动，标志着前沿 AI 在保持高性能的同时，价格门槛显著降低。
headline.title_en: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT‑5.6
headline.summary_en: OpenAI announced major price cuts for GPT-5.6: Terra down 20% and Luna down 80%, enabled by optimizations using GPT-5.6 Sol. This marks a significant step in making frontier AI more affordable while maintaining high performance.
headline.original_title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT‑5.6
headline.reason: GPT-5.6 的大幅降价直接冲击 AI 行业成本结构，是当日最具广泛影响的行业新闻，影响开发者、企业和投资方向。
headline.reason_en: The steep price drop for GPT-5.6 reshapes AI cost structures, making it the most impactful story of the day for developers, enterprises, and investors.
